## 🤖 Claude *(13:06:42)*


## 🤖 Claude *(13:06:42)*

A real bug — and exactly the class that aborts an entire clip. A whitespace-only phrase (`'   '`) passes the `phrase.length` filter but produces zero word spans; my per-word loop iterated `k < W` where `W = spans.length || 1`, so it indexed `spans[0]` on an empty collection and threw. Fixing at both layers.
